rows.en: Our advance units report <pic(0)>the <cs(3)>enemy raiding force<ce()> has split up and is fleeing.
rows.speaker: ? (Bright Noa or Noin)

rows.en: A short while ago, we picked up the trail of <mk(25,-25,1,1)><ar(0,1,1,50)>one of those units.
rows.speaker: ? (Bright Noa or Noin)

rows.en: <mk(-25,25,1,0)><ar(0,1,0,50)>We'll now rush to <pic(1)>the <cs(3)>site<ce()> and conduct an operation to retake the classified material.
rows.speaker: ? (Bright Noa or Noin)

rows.en: I know you're uneasy going into battle with so many wounded aboard, but steel yourselves.
rows.speaker: ? (Bright Noa or Noin)

rows.en: We also recovered another <pic(2)><cs(3)>new model<ce()> from the UCE base.
rows.speaker: ? (Bright Noa or Noin)

rows.en: It's untested even in drills, but should help in the battles ahead. Take care of it.
rows.speaker: ? (Bright Noa or Noin)

rows.en: It seems the Poseidal Army's aim is to sell the classified material to other factions.
rows.speaker: Dermail?

rows.en: Perhaps they've given up on taking Earth. They've sunk to mere warmongering, it seems.
rows.speaker: Dermail?

rows.en: That cursed Lady Poseidal... We must hurry and recapture it.
rows.speaker: Dermail?

rows.en: To deal with this, it was decided to reorganize <cs(1)>Londo Bell<ce()> as a dedicated pursuit unit.
rows.speaker: Dermail?

rows.en: This mission calls for great strength, so each body of our UCE has lent us forces.
rows.speaker: Dermail?

rows.en: Four ships in all: yours, the <cs(1)>Nadesico B<ce()>, the <cs(1)>Gran Garan<ce()> and the <cs(1)>Peacemillion<ce()>.
rows.speaker: Dermail?

rows.en: They are already on the move. I want you to proceed in coordination with them.
rows.speaker: Dermail?

rows.en: Gather the scattered units' personnel as you go, and carry out your mission flexibly.
rows.speaker: Dermail?

rows.en: So you're just a ragtag unit after all. It seems I was a fool to expect anything of you.
rows.speaker: Dermail?
